_comment: Seal source of truth (Day 10). README results table and the resume MUST render from this file; regenerate everything with the commands in each entry. Tree: ros2_tunnel_explorer bline-merge-20260908; D-line linear_mpc_controller cloud-exploration-20260908.
_gauge: All grid numbers gauge odom against masks generated by plan_from_map over the map the sim actually served (cleaning_room_rect.yaml, origin -3.0/-2.0; verified via map_server logs). Earlier map_saved-mask grid numbers (0.2486/0.2836 historical and first-pass Day 6-8) were a frame mismatch and are RETRACTED.

coverage_chain.segments: 36-37/37 covered per run, 0-1 failed (run6: one WORK_TRACKING_FAILED)
coverage_chain.served_map: cleaning_room_rect (static), origin -3.0/-2.0; executable cells 6996; python-canonical route 60.75 m / 22 waypoints
reproduce: python3 <tunnel>/scripts/regen_plan_from_masks.py --masks <audit_masks.npz> --outdir <dir>  (python plan reproducibility over a given map)
python3 <D-line>/benchmark_tools/scripts/plan_from_map.py --map-yaml <served map yaml> --outdir <dir>  (gauge masks over the served map)
coverage_chain.claim: segment ledger stable (+/-1.5%, executor-internal); grid coverage_task 0.221-0.261 (mean 0.238) is map-area coverage of the driven path against the served-map executable mask -- NOT a plan-trace match to the python route; report RANGE + both denominators; executor ledger != absolute coverage.

excluded: run1, run2, run3: aborted before the tunnel_worlds asset import (missing cleaning_room_rect world/map -> gz 255 / map_server failed -> executor never READY_IDLE -> empty odom bag -> zero audits).  Retained only as failure artifacts under chain_day68/records; not part of any reported statistic.

claims_resume: Implements a STATE-HELD Frenet windowed projection + displacement-budget acceptance gate replacing stateless global nearest-point, eliminating lane mis-attachment on folding/reversing paths (A5.1/A5.2/A4.2 reacquire; C++ mirror + tests).

Designed a 3-geometry x 2-v_min x 2-projection-mode 12-cell ablation matrix; located the true failure axis as path geometry and v_min, NOT the projection implementation (10/12 cells bit-identical across projection modes), and on that basis decided NO maneuver-generation layer is needed.

Ran per-point kinematic-feasibility audit of the planner output: 16/250 reference points exceed the angular-velocity bound, giving the fix criterion v <= omega_max/|kappa| (implemented, D-line 85276e3; omega_violations guard).
C++/Python cross-language projection golden parity check (projection_golden.json shared file consumed by both sides; ctest projection_golden + pytest parity suite).
a9_decisions: cap geometry passes at both v_min -> no maneuver-generation layer
nocap v_min=0 stalls -> needs negative-velocity authority
backward geometry stalls -> needs true reversing kinematics

claims_resume: nav2_core::Controller plugin loaded by controller_server; the robot pose is transformed into the path frame each cycle so the cross-cycle projection-gate state is never silently reset (setReference only on setPlan).

Defines a graded failure contract: InvalidPath on degenerate plans, ControllerTFError on tf loss, NoValidControl on PROJECTION_LOST / ambiguous projection / consecutive QP failures, zero velocity WITHOUT throw while reacquire-seeking.
Negative control proves the terminal-stop clamp: removing it overshoots 2.36 m arc end by 13.14-13.16 m vs intact 1.977/1.979 m (delta 11.18 m; docx-recorded 13.37 m-class reproduced).
Sandbox gates: stage1 lifecycle 4/4, straight 7/7, arc 8/8.

boundaries: No hard real-time statement is authorized.

Executor plans internally via C++ ScanlinePlanner over the served static map; python cleaning_mode is canonical only for plan reproducibility over the served map (60.75 m / 22 waypoints on cleaning_room_rect) and is NOT route-identical to the executor's segments.
Chain controller = RotationShim + DWB; the linear-MPC plugin is a separate sandbox-verified deliverable.
map_saved-gauge coverage numbers (historical 0.2486/0.2836) are retracted as coverage claims.
U9-era entrance-hysteresis A/B numbers (1/5, 590 s, -45% goals) are NOT reproducible from any committed tree and are excluded from README and resume.
